privacy-policy.metaDescription: Learn how Lotus Ceylon International Tours & Services (Pvt) Ltd protects your personal data, inquiry details, and privacy in compliance with international standards.
privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Our sacred commitment to guest confidentiality, data security, and respectful communication.
privacy-policy.disclaimerHtml: Commitment to Privacy: Lotus Ceylon International Tours & Services strictly protects the confidentiality of your personal data. We never sell, lease, or monetize your information.
privacy-policy.bodyHtml:
1. Information We Collect

To design your personalized travel itinerary and fulfill reservations, we collect necessary personal details, including:

  • Full names, nationalities, and passport details (as required for hotel check-ins and wildlife park entry permits).
  • Contact information, including email address, mobile phone number, and preferred messaging handles (WhatsApp, WeChat, or LINE).
  • Travel preferences, flight arrival/departure schedules, dietary requirements, and mobility considerations.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your data is used solely to:

  • Design, quote, and execute your private travel itinerary.
  • Secure reservations with boutique hotels, tea estates, private safari jeeps, and scenic train tickets.
  • Coordinate seamless airport VIP meet-and-greet services upon arrival in Colombo.
  • Provide real-time concierge coordination and safety monitoring during your stay in Sri Lanka.

3. Data Security & Storage

All communications and guest records are stored in secure, encrypted cloud environments. Access is restricted strictly to authorized Lotus Ceylon travel designers and concierge personnel.

4. Third-Party Disclosures

We only share essential traveler details with vetted operational partners strictly necessary for the execution of your trip (e.g., boutique hotels for guest check-in, Department of Wildlife Conservation for park permits, Sri Lanka Railways for train seat bookings). We never disclose guest information to third-party marketing companies.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to request access to your personal data, request corrections, or request complete deletion of your records from our systems following the completion of your journey. Inquiries may be addressed to: paliforbuddhism@gmail.com.

terms-conditions.metaTitle: Terms & Conditions | Lotus Ceylon Luxury Tours & Services
terms-conditions.metaDescription: Official terms and booking conditions for private tailor-made tours, chauffeur guide services, and travel arrangements with Lotus Ceylon.
terms-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
paragraphs: Clear, transparent, and fair booking conditions for our discerning global guests.
terms-conditions.bodyHtml:
1. Introduction & Booking Confirmation

Lotus Ceylon International Tours & Services (Private) Limited (hereafter referred to as "Lotus Ceylon", "we", "us", or "our") specializes in bespoke, private inbound journeys across Sri Lanka. A booking is confirmed when your customized itinerary is mutually agreed upon in writing, and the requisite deposit has been received.

2. 100% Tailor-Made Private Journeys

Every itinerary designed by Lotus Ceylon is private. You will not be merged with third-party tour groups or shared coach departures. Your designated air-conditioned private vehicle and government-licensed chauffeur guide are exclusively reserved for your traveling party.

3. Pricing & Currency

All tour quotations are clearly stated in US Dollars (USD) or your preferred currency as confirmed in writing. Quotations include all private road transportation, certified chauffeur-guide services, curated accommodation as specified, and entry permits as listed in your itinerary. International airfares and personal gratuities are excluded unless explicitly noted.

4. Traveler Health, Insurance & Documentation

All travelers are responsible for obtaining comprehensive personal travel insurance covering medical expenses, emergency repatriation, trip cancellation, and baggage loss. All travelers must hold a passport with at least six months of validity from the date of entry and obtain a valid Sri Lankan Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA / eVisa) prior to departure.

5. Force Majeure & Environmental Disruption

Lotus Ceylon shall not be liable for changes, delays, or cancellations caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to severe weather anomalies, natural disasters, national strikes, government travel restrictions, or airport closures. In such rare events, we work diligently to reschedule your arrangements or offer equivalent alternative boutique accommodations without administrative penalty.

6. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Any disputes arising hereunder shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Sri Lanka.

cancellation-policy.metaTitle: Cancellation & Refund Policy | Lotus Ceylon Luxury Holidays
cancellation-policy.metaDescription: Review Lotus Ceylon's fair cancellation terms, deposit refund schedules, and flexible rescheduling policies for luxury Sri Lanka holiday bookings.
cancellation-policy.title: Cancellation & Payment Policy
paragraphs: Transparent terms designed with fairness, flexibility, and guest peace of mind.
cancellation-policy.disclaimerHtml: Flexible Postponement Assurance: We recognize that travel plans can be disrupted by unforeseen circumstances. Where permissible by hotel partners, Lotus Ceylon offers flexible rescheduling of dates.
cancellation-policy.bodyHtml:
1. Booking Deposit

To confirm your bespoke itinerary and secure your chauffeur allocation and boutique accommodations, a deposit of 20% to 30% of the total tour value is required. The specific deposit amount will be stated on your formal booking quotation.

2. Balance Payment

The remaining balance is due 30 days prior to your arrival in Sri Lanka. For reservations finalized within 30 days of arrival, full payment is required upon confirmation.

3. Standard Cancellation Schedule

Should you need to cancel your confirmed journey, notification must be submitted in writing via email. The following standard cancellation charges apply:

  • 45 days or more prior to arrival: Deposit refunded less unavoidable bank processing fees and pre-issued non-refundable permits.
  • 30 to 44 days prior to arrival: 25% of total tour cost retained.
  • 15 to 29 days prior to arrival: 50% of total tour cost retained.
  • 4. Peak Season & Non-Refundable Items

    Reservations falling within the festive peak season (December 20 – January 10) or during the historic Kandy Esala Perahera festival are subject to strict non-refundable terms imposed by boutique properties. Similarly, pre-purchased first-class scenic train tickets and national park safari permits are non-refundable once issued by government departments.

    5. Rescheduling Policy

    If you need to postpone your journey due to medical emergencies or flight cancellations, we will coordinate with all partner properties to transfer your funds to new travel dates within a 12-month period, subject to seasonal rate adjustments.

cookie-policy.metaTitle: Cookie Policy | Lotus Ceylon International Tours & Services
cookie-policy.metaDescription: Information about the cookies and local storage technologies used on the Lotus Ceylon website to optimize language preferences and site performance.
cookie-policy.title: Cookie Notice
paragraphs: Transparent information about our essential, privacy-first website cookies.
cookie-policy.disclaimerHtml: Privacy-First Browsing: Lotus Ceylon operates a clean, privacy-conscious website. We do not employ intrusive tracking pixels or sell user behavioral data.
cookie-policy.bodyHtml:
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your browser to ensure website functionality, remember language preferences, and deliver seamless navigation.

2. How We Use Cookies

  • Essential Functional Cookies: Necessary to maintain session state, remember your selected language (English, Chinese, German, etc.), and process inquiry submissions.
  • Performance & Map Rendering: Used by our interactive Leaflet OpenStreetMap components to cache map tiles locally and deliver lightning-fast interactive routes.
  • Media Delivery: Allows Cloudinary and browser caches to load high-resolution imagery and WebP formats without redundant data usage.

3. Managing Your Cookie Preferences

You can choose to disable or clear cookies at any time via your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may reset your selected language preference to default English on subsequent visits.
